value.body: The Department of Atomic Energy recruits Scientific Officers through the BARC Training Schools. Under OCES, selected engineering graduates and science postgraduates do a one-year paid training course and are then posted as Scientific Officers in BARC or another DAE unit. DGFS is a parallel scheme that funds an M.Tech before placement.

items.label: OCES training
items.note: At BARC Training Schools (Mumbai and AMD Hyderabad in the 2026 cycle)

items.label: Post on completion
items.note: Level 10 of the 7th CPC pay matrix

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Engineering: B.E./B.Tech in an eligible branch with at least 60%. Science: an M.Sc or integrated M.Sc / BS-MS in an eligible subject (physics, chemistry, biosciences and others) with at least 60%; a B.Sc alone is not enough for OCES. Candidates are shortlisted through BARC's online exam or a valid GATE score, and final selection is by interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Taking both the BARC online test and GATE gives two chances to be shortlisted.
Selected trainees sign a bond to serve DAE for at least three years after training.
B.Sc graduates can look at separate BARC/DAE notices for Stipendiary Trainee and Scientific Assistant posts.
